response.original_title: WWE Monday Night Raw in Mexico City special
response.overview: The Monday Night Raw in Mexico City special is an upcoming American professional wrestling television special that will be produced by WWE. The program will be broadcast on the streaming service Netflix. It is set to take place on September 14, 2026, from Arena CDMX in Mexico City, Mexico, and will feature performers from the Raw brand. It will also feature the main roster debut of Lola Vice.  This episode is the main fallout of Triplemanía 34. The main event will see Roman Reigns defend his World Heavyweight Championship against Penta, who won an eight-man single-elimination tournament that was open to luchadores from the Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA), Raw, and SmackDown rosters.
